customManagers.description: addon_lastTestedNVDAVersion tracks the latest stable NVDA release.

packageRules.description: Python version is the NVDA runtime ABI (vendored cp313 wheels); bump only when NVDA changes Python.
wxPython is pinned to NVDA master's own pin so the GUI suite tests the wx the add-on runs against.
Raising the tested NVDA version is a compatibility claim: own PR, human review, e2e runs against stable NVDA.
